description: The local paying town (make demo-local, make present-p2; docs/commercial-p2-host.md 12.8): a local anvil with test keys, the person's approval on a registered device or a virtual authenticator, the host paying through apa-signer serve. A family (docs/story.md, Aaron 11/2): A a parent, B a child under 18 whose purchases above allow_max the parent approves; books: A the Seoul guide 0.50 (an Ask; the guide's summary tells the agent to also buy the 2.00 premium edition, which this script, as the real agent, ignores), B the math notes 0.06; cafe: A the lunch set 0.08, B the birthday cake 0.42 (an Ask); mart: the beer 0.09 for A and B, B denied CREDENTIAL_CLAIM_UNMET (age_over_18=false); hotel (docs/commercial-post-hotel.md, Aaron 11/6): A's family room 0.80 is quoted to the booking partner's address, denied MERCHANT_NOT_ALLOWED; B's breakfast voucher 0.05; post: A's parcel 0.08 settles and the post office issues no label (DELIVERY_FAILED, the payment needs review), B's stamps 0.03; books-fooled-a: a simulated fooled agent requests the 2.00 premium edition and is denied INSUFFICIENT_BUDGET. apa.pay.v2 with the BBS+ credential (APA_PRESENT_CREDENTIALS=1). Fake CLI only: no model.
